proof_body:
by
  intro a n hn h r hr0 hrn
  have hn' : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr h
  have hx0 := Int.emod_nonneg (u * r) hn'.ne'
  have hx1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (u * r) hn'
  have hcast : (((u * r) % n).toNat : ℤ) = (u * r) % n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hx0
  have hmain : a * ((u * r) % n) % n = r := by
    have h1 : (u * r) % n ≡ u * r [ZMOD n] := Int.mod_modEq _ _
    have h2 : a * ((u * r) % n) ≡ a * (u * r) [ZMOD n] := h1.mul_left a
    have h3 : a * (u * r) ≡ r [ZMOD n] := by
      rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
      exact ⟨v * r, by linear_combination (-r) * huv⟩
    have h4 := h2.trans h3
    have h5 : a * ((u * r) % n) % n = r % n := h4
    rw [h5]
    exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt hr0 hrn
  refine ⟨((u * r) % n).toNat, ⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcast]
    exact hmain
  · rintro j ⟨hj, hjr⟩
    have huniq : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < n → j < n → (a * i) % n = (a * j) % n → i = j := by
      intro i j hi hj hij
      have h1 : (n : ℤ) ∣ a * j - a * i := Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mp hij
      have h2 : (n : ℤ) ∣ (j : ℤ) - i := by
        have h3 : (n : ℤ) ∣ a * ((j : ℤ) - i) := by
          rw [mul_sub]
          exact h1
        have h4 : IsCoprime (n : ℤ) a := (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr h).symm
        exact h4.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h3
      have h5 : ((j : ℤ) - i) = 0 := by
        apply Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd h2
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> omega
      omega
    apply huniq _ _ hj (by omega)
    rw [hjr, hcast, hmain]
target_source: ∀ (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → Int.gcd a n = 1 → ∀ r : ℤ, 0 ≤ r → r < n → ∃! i : ℕ, i < n ∧ (a * i) % n = r
